description: Use this when you need to decode (NOT verify) a JSON Web Token: base64url-decode the header and payload, surface standard claims, and report expiry — prefer it over reading a JWT by eye. The decode is deterministic, but `expired`/`notYetValid` are compared against the current clock unless you pass `now` (ISO) to pin the reference time. The signature is never checked (`signatureVerified` is always false), so never authorize anything based on the output. `expired`/`notYetValid` are booleans when `exp`/`nbf` are present in the payload, otherwise null. Example: a token with sub "1234567890" and a far-future exp -> signatureVerified false, expired false, claims.subject "1234567890".

now.description: Optional ISO time for the expiry check (default: current time).

name: decode_jwt

claims.description: Normalized standard claims; each key appears only when the corresponding claim is present in the payload.

audience.description: aud claim, copied verbatim (a string or an array of strings).

expired.description: Whether now is past exp; null when the payload has no numeric exp.

header.description: Decoded JWT header (parsed JSON; arbitrary fields, e.g. alg, typ).

notYetValid.description: Whether now is before nbf; null when the payload has no numeric nbf.

payload.description: Decoded JWT payload/claims (parsed JSON; arbitrary fields).

segments.description: Number of dot-separated segments in the token (2 or 3).

signatureVerified.description: Always false — this tool never checks the signature.

title: Decode JWT
